page_note: 本页为IEA《Renewables 2025》第30页正文，中部含一幅无编号图：五个欧洲国家2021-2024年居民电价（柱、左轴EUR/MWh）与净新增装机（折线、右轴GW）的组合图。

heading.title: Residential sector retail electricity prices and annual capacity additions in selected European countries, 2021-2024

components.evidence: four coloured bars (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) side by side within each country slot
left axis 'EUR/MWh' 0-800, right axis 'GW' 0.0-4.0 for 'Net additions (right axis)'
bars plus a black line with open circle markers in the same panel
legend row '2024 2023 2022 2021 Net additions (right axis)' sits under the country axis
'EUR/MWh' set vertically at left, 'GW' set vertically at right
bare ticks 0-800 and 0.0-4.0; scale only from 'EUR/MWh' and 'GW' axis titles
legend entry reads 'Net additions (right axis)' pointing to the GW axis
faint horizontal rules across the plot at 100-unit steps, no vertical rules
country names under bracketed group separators spanning each set of four bars
'IEA. CC BY 4.0.' small print under the plot area

new_components.name: line_series_break_between_groups
new_components.evidence: the net-additions line restarts within each country group, not connected across Belgium-Germany-Italy
new_components.why_it_matters: 折线是每国内部四年的独立段，读点必须先定国家再定年份，否则会跨国错配数值。

new_components.name: license_credit_line
new_components.evidence: 'IEA. CC BY 4.0.' printed right-aligned below the figure instead of a Source: line
new_components.why_it_matters: 该图没有Source行，只有版权行；解析器若按Source定位图尾，会漏掉图注边界。

new_components.name: reversed_legend_order
new_components.evidence: legend order 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021 while bars are drawn 2021 to 2024 left to right
new_components.why_it_matters: 图例顺序与柱的绘制顺序相反，按图例次序取值会把年份系列整体颠倒。

spot_checks.mark: the Belgium 2021 bar (yellow, leftmost of the group)
the Netherlands 2022 bar (orange), the shortest bar on the figure
the Italy 2021 bar (yellow); Spain 2023/2024 bars are also near this height
a net-additions point on the right GW axis, e.g. the Belgium 2023 marker near the 1.0 gridline
the Germany 2023 net-additions marker, the highest point on the line (between 3.0 and 4.0)
a net-additions marker slightly above 1.0, e.g. Italy 2022
a net-additions marker between 1.0 and 2.0, e.g. Belgium 2022 or Netherlands 2021
a low net-additions marker just above the 0.0 line, e.g. Spain 2021

difficulty_notes: 右轴GW只有0.0/1.0/2.0/3.0/4.0五个刻度，约1.0单位对应26像素；要把1.1、1.2、1.3区分到5%容差（即±0.06 GW）需分辨约1.5像素，而折线标记本身直径就有5像素以上，实际不可达；左轴柱虽有100间隔的水平网格，290与350这类值的5%容差（±15与±17.5）仍要求半格以内判读，且图上完全没有数值标签。相比之下标签只需三键（国家+年份+系列/单位），并不构成主要障碍。

suggestions.what_to_add: dual_axis 与 mixed_marks 的组合（柱+右轴折线）作为独立生成条件
suggestions.where_to_change: 图表族条件表中新增“双轴混合标记”一行，样式字段需指定右轴系列名带(right axis)
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 左轴柱值 vs 右轴折线值分别计算命中率，检验解析器是否把折线点错读到左轴刻度

suggestions.what_to_add: new_components 中的 line_series_break_between_groups（分组内断开的折线）
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段增加 group_id，使折线按类别组分段绘制
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 折线连续跨组 vs 按组断开两种设置下，点值定位到正确国家的准确率

suggestions.what_to_add: 每个刻度间隔较大的次级轴（0.0–4.0仅5格）对应的 per-mark 可读精度评估
suggestions.where_to_change: 评测的 readable 判定改为按标记给出可达精度（依据像素/刻度比）
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 按标记可达精度分档（≤2%、2–5%、>5%）分别统计得分

suggestions.what_to_add: 无编号图但有粗体彩色标题+版权行的页面结构（含 rotated_axis_title 与 two_level_x_ticks）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题字段拆分为 number/title/subtitle/unit/placement，允许 number 为空、unit 落在旋转轴标题上
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 标题无编号且单位仅在旋转轴标题时，表格上下文命中率对比有编号图
